title: Biallelic truncating variants in PACSIN3 cause childhood-onset myopathy with hyperCKaemia.

reviewer.method: This continuation personally read all 660 lines of the held publisher full-text rendering, all Figure1 panels A-H and the entire one-page supplementary full-length blot PDF. All three source-context patients, both selected and the alternate, all four allele descriptors and all45 phenotype assertions were individually compared. This is new reading; prior retrieval receipts are attributed to the earlier retrieval team.

audit.exposure_note: Required HANDOFF reading exposed aggregate history and a historical public-control HG002/FGFR2 case-specific rank. No target-case inference ranks, inference-output files or benchmark outcome summaries consulted. This review is not blinded.

patient_identity.statement: Exact female Individual1 matches this packet. Family1 first child; age5y examination, born32weeks.

genotype.statement: Compound heterozygous NM_016223.5:c.270_277del p.Leu91AlafsTer15 and c.609_610del p.Lys203AsnfsTer4. Source coding/transcript/protein/zygosity match; genomic HGVS and VCF representations not independently remapped.
limitations: Source does not report the packet genomic HGVS/VCF coordinates; absence of remapping is retained.

segregation.statement: Both healthy parents are heterozygous carriers; mother carries c.270_277del, father c.609_610del in Figure1A.

phase.statement: Sanger-confirmed compound heterozygosity with one variant from each parent (trans).

causal_confidence.statement: The report supports a recessive PACSIN3 myopathy association through three individuals/two families, segregation and absent detectable PACSIN3 in patient fibroblasts. This is reported evidence, not independent confirmation.
limitations: Small discovery series; exact caveolar mechanism explicitly unresolved. Normal caveolin-3 staining; NMD predicted, not directly assayed. No independent variant remapping or rescue result established by this audit.

phenotype_completeness.statement: This packet is a selective phenotype representation. It omits prematurity32weeks, normal cognition/cardiac work-up/metabolic screens and detailed ultrastructure; early hypotonia and normal tone at5y are distinct timepoints.
limitations: The report is not a comprehensive negative-phenotype examination; packet exclusions beyond explicit source findings remain unresolved.
